title: The phone menu shows a Spaces tile where Mindless was

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16: "Replace mindless with spaces in the ios menu. Use icons from the design system"

detail: The phone drawer's core-feature tile grid (DRAWER_TILES) carried a Mindless tile. It becomes a Spaces tile with the design system's space glyph, landing on /spaces/directory, the same place the desktop Business Spaces shortcut goes. Mindless stays one tap away in the Zap sheet and in The Quest section.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/header.tsx','utf8');const t=s.slice(s.indexOf('const DRAWER_TILES'),s.indexOf('type MenuAction'));const bad=[];if(!/label: 'Spaces', href: '\/spaces\/directory', icon: 'space'/.test(t))bad.push('no Spaces tile');if(/label: 'Mindless'/.test(t))bad.push('Mindless tile still there');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-996: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
